HERO.SUBTITLE: Frontend developer on my way to full-stack. Passionate about tech, UI/UX & design.

SOFT_SKILLS.TITLE: Soft skills that stay.
SOFT_SKILLS.P1: Good software is built where people trust each other and talk openly. That’s the kind of team I’m looking for: people I can learn from and give something back to in return.
SOFT_SKILLS.P2: I’m a trained media designer and then spent four years working in after-school care. There, I made films with children, produced audiobooks and built a blog – and learned to explain things in a way that truly sticks. My team elected me as their team spokesperson. Humour and a genuine eagerness to learn something new every day simply come naturally to me.

HARD_SKILLS.TITLE: Hard skills that grow.
HARD_SKILLS.P1: I completed my training as a frontend developer in September 2026. Angular, TypeScript and SCSS are my foundation, and I’m currently expanding it with Python and Django. Coming from a design background, I know how design, frontend and UX fit together.
HARD_SKILLS.P2: I think in structures, would rather ask one question too many than one too few, and like to explore topics that go beyond the course – from modern CSS features to AI-assisted workflows.

SKILLS.TITLE: My evolving skillset
SKILLS.SUBTITLE: An honest look at my current tech stack. The foundation is solid, and the rest grows with every new commit.

LIGHT_DARK.NAME: Light & Dark
LIGHT_DARK.DESCRIPTION: A 2D browser game, fully object-oriented and built with vanilla JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas – without any framework. The game design and sprite sheets are my own. The focus was on smooth animations, custom audio handling and a high-performance game loop.

JOIN.NAME: Join
JOIN.DESCRIPTION: A Kanban tool for teams, built as a single page application with Angular, TypeScript and Supabase. At the start, I took over coordination and set up the technical foundation. Drag & drop, contact management and a responsive SCSS layout all work hand in hand.

POKEDEX.NAME: PokeDex
POKEDEX.DESCRIPTION: A web app that asynchronously loads data from an external REST API and displays it dynamically – with a fast live search and a responsive layout in HTML and CSS.

KANMIND.NAME: KanMind (WIP)
KANMIND.DESCRIPTION: My current backend project: for an existing Kanban frontend, I’m building my own secured REST API for data management with Python and Django.

INCUSYNC.NAME: INCUSYNC
INCUSYNC.DESCRIPTION: An unofficial configuration tool for Equalizer APO, built with Angular, TypeScript and Canvas. It turns the results of a hearing test into a ready-to-use equalizer file, so people with hearing loss can adjust their PC sound without technical knowledge. The focus: accessibility and clear user guidance. The preview currently works on desktop only.

TESTIMONIALS.TITLE: Voices Along the Way
TESTIMONIALS.SUBTITLE: How my teammates have experienced working together with me on our shared projects.

1.TEXT: Timo was the structural backbone of our project. From day one, he set up a clean architecture and global styling, which made working together as a team incredibly smooth. He works in an extremely structured way and masters even difficult technical challenges with ease.
1.AUTHOR: Jermaine Jérôme Bärwolf

2.TEXT: Timo is an absolute must-have for any CSS-heavy project. He has a sharp, logical mind and is always there when the team gets stuck. From the very beginning, he contributed brilliant ideas and implemented them flawlessly. His technical expertise and proactive attitude are outstanding.
2.AUTHOR: Kevin Reinhold Triebe

3.TEXT: Timo is a very competent and organised colleague who also convinces as a team leader. He has enormous expertise, especially in CSS, and works very meticulously and attentively. Timo is a great colleague who enriches every team.
3.AUTHOR: Magdalena Laurisch
